lessons.title: Practice Frozen Dataclass Config
lessons.description: Finish with_port. Create an immutable Config dataclass and a helper that updates via dataclasses.replace. The test checks that with_port(c, 8080).port equals 8080; Config('localhost').port equals 80.
learning_objectives: Ridge wardens recount crates before dawn, and use frozen True and replace.

tests.name: test_config
tests.unittest_code:
def test_config(self):
    c = Config('localhost')
    c2 = with_port(c, 8080)
    self.assertEqual(c2.port, 8080)
    self.assertEqual(c.port, 80)

source.name: Python official documentation (docs.python.org) — dataclasses — frozen=True and dataclasses.replace()
